components.text: Despite the name, a Mimic isn't a monster - it's a block that can take on the appearance of almost any other block while remaining what it really is underneath. Sneak-place one against an existing block to swap that block for a Mimic wearing its old appearance, or right-click an already-placed, plain Mimic with a block in hand to dress it up the same way.

The Ethereal Mimic variant is completely intangible - you walk straight through it - which makes it handy for concealing pitfall traps or secret passages behind a convincing wall or floor. Keep an eye out; the dungeon generator places these naturally throughout the Demon Dungeon (see Exploring the Dungeon).
